propositions: Project-supplied code-review criteria with applies_to are stored and never validated or read during dispatch, causing them to run on every review regardless of changed files.
The dispatch path in _activated_code_review_project_criteria filters only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, never examining applies_to or changed files.
applies_to validation is absent from _validate_routing_entry in overlay.py, allowing malformed values to silently revert to always-on behavior.
Project code-review criteria should be gated by applying glob matching against changed_files, reusing the same mechanism and file list as the triggers step.
applies_to must gain shape validation at overlay load to reject non-list, non-string, or empty-string glob values rather than silently narrowing to empty.

An empty applies_to for project criteria means ungated/always-runs (forced by design since project ids are not in OVERLAY_IDS), requiring documentation of this semantic collision with built-in overlay behavior.
